neighbours.label: the digit '0' closing 'base 10' and similar number-system terms in technical descriptions
fire: In this file format every count is stored in base 10 by default.
Most people do arithmetic in base 10 because they have ten fingers.
The flag tells the parser to read the integer in base 10.
Convert the binary string to base 10 before printing it.
Our clocks mix base 60 for minutes with base 10 for everything else.
The calculator shows each result in base 10 unless you change the mode.
A logarithm in base 10 is often called a common logarithm.
Students first learn place value using base 10 blocks.
quiet: In this file format every count is stored as plain decimal text by default.
Most people do arithmetic with decimals because they have ten fingers.
The flag tells the parser to read the integer as hexadecimal.
Convert the binary string to a decimal number before printing it.
Our clocks mix sixties for minutes with tens for everything else.
The calculator shows each result as a decimal unless you change the mode.
A natural logarithm uses the constant e as its base.
Students first learn place value using small wooden blocks.
